Ben Shapiro wrote a movie in just FOUR DAYS—and then landed Rob Lowe, James Franco, Nick Nolte, and an all-star Hollywood cast to bring it to life. In an exclusive behind-the-scenes interview with Ben’s Editorial Producer Sarah Steele, Ben reveals how Confession came together, from the viral trailer and casting process to the inspiration behind the portrayal of Stalin’s Soviet Union. Ben breaks down the film’s exploration of communism, faith, tyranny, and individual freedom, plus why he believes Confession is the most ambitious project The Daily Wire has ever produced.
